light.directSun.reason: 出典は半日の日なたを最適とするが、シダの葉焼けを避けるため室内では直射日光を避けるとした

temperature.idealC.quote: ( Polypodium aureum ) 2 or more feet long Bright indirect or filtered sunlight. Night temperatures of 50 to 55 °F and day temperatures of 68 to 72 °F.

watering.growing.quote: It tolerates drying out between waterings.
a moist but not soggy substrate
